authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant physical plausibility artifacts that undermine its authenticity. Most critically, the candles penetrate the cookie without any material displacement, cracking, or melting at the insertion points—the wax appears to fuse seamlessly with the dough, violating basic physics (structural collapse, severity 3). Additionally, the raccoons display a plastic, molded texture rather than biological fur (texture anomaly, severity 2), and the center raccoon suffers from perspective distortion/flattening behind the central candle (severity 2). While lighting and overall rendering quality are high, these structural and textural inconsistencies substantially reduce authenticity. The initial score of 3.2 was appropriate given multiple moderate-to-severe artifacts; no adjustment is warranted.
